1: // Minimal Cosmic Dodger game
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: if (!canvas) throw new Error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
6: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
7: 
8: // generate star field background
9: const stars = [];
10: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
11:   stars.push({ x: Math.random() * canvas.width, y: Math.random() * canvas.height, size: Math.random() * 2 + 1 });
12: }
13: 
14: // particle effect for explosions
15: const particles = [];
16: function spawnExplosion(x, y) {
17:   for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
18:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
19:     const speed = Math.random() * 3 + 1;
20:     particles.push({ x, y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, radius: Math.random() * 2 + 1, life: 60 });
21:   }
22: }
23: 
24: 
25: // Ship configuration
26: const ship = { w: 40, h: 20, x: canvas.width / 2 - 20, y: canvas.height - 30, speed: 5 };
27: 
28: // Asteroid pool
29: const asteroids = [];
30: let asteroidTimer = 0;
31: const asteroidFreq = 60; // frames
32: let score = 0;
33: let gameOver = false;
34: 
35: function spawnAsteroid() {
36:   const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
37:   const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
38:   asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: Math.random() * 2 + 2, angle });
39:   const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
40:   asteroids.push({ x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size), y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed: Math.random() * 2 + 2 });
41: }
42: 
43: function update() {
44:   // Update particles
45:   for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
46:     const p = particles[i];
47:     p.x += p.vx;
48:     p.y += p.vy;
49:     p.life--;
50:     if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
51:   }
52:   if (gameOver) return;
53:   // Move ship based on input
54:   if (keys['ArrowLeft'] && ship.x > 0) ship.x -= ship.speed;
55:   if (keys['ArrowRight'] && ship.x + ship.w < canvas.width) ship.x += ship.speed;
56: 
57:   // Spawn asteroids
58:   if (asteroidTimer++ > asteroidFreq) { spawnAsteroid(); playTone(300, 80); asteroidTimer = 0; }
59: 
60:   // Update asteroids
61:   for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
62:     const a = asteroids[i];
63:     a.y += a.speed;
64:     // Remove off‑screen
65:     if (a.y > canvas.height) { asteroids.splice(i, 1); score++; }
66:     // Collision
67:     if (a.x < ship.x + ship.w && a.x + a.w > ship.x && a.y < ship.y + ship.h && a.y + a.h > ship.y) {
68:       spawnExplosion(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
69:       playTone(150, 300);
70:       gameOver = true; break;
71:     }
72:   }
73: }
74: 
75: function draw() {
76:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
77:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
78:   // draw stars background
79:   ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
80:   stars.forEach(s => {
81:     ctx.beginPath();
82:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
83:     ctx.fill();
84:   });
85:   // Draw ship as a triangle
86:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
87:   ctx.beginPath();
88:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
89:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
90:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
91:   ctx.closePath();
92:   ctx.fill();
93:   // Draw asteroids
94:   ctx.fillStyle = '#a44';
95:   asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h));
96:   // Score
97:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
98:   ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
99:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
100:   if (gameOver) {
101:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
102:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
103:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
104:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
105:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 120, canvas.height / 2);
106:   }
107: }
108: 
109: function loop() {
110:   update();
111:   draw();
112:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
113: }
114: 
115: const keys = {};
116: // Audio setup using Web Audio API
117: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
118: function playTone(freq, duration) {
119:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
120:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
121:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
122:   osc.type = 'square';
123:   osc.connect(gain);
124:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
125:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
126:   osc.start();
127:   setTimeout(() => osc.stop(), duration);
128: }
129: 
130: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
131: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
132: 
133: loop();
